text: What'd you get mom for Christmas? I don't have any money, so I just got her a cheap candle. Okay, well I don't have much money either, but I got her the new digital picture frame. This is a digital picture frame that allows you to upload any photo from your phone. Not only can you display the photos both vertically and horizontally with the weather and time, but I can't believe it's that price right now. There's a bunch of different settings to adjust how the picture looks, and you can even change the timing of the slideshow. The coolest part is your friends and family from literally anywhere can also add photos to the frame. Now the only issue is this sells out really quick with the holidays, so if you wanna take advantage of the affordable price while it's still in stock, I'll try to link it somewhere down below. Just make sure if you see it available, you grab it before it's gone.
